digest.component_or_area: LLM prompt caching and structured runs
propositions: Prompt cache writes occur on every plan-review gate call but are never read across calls, generating premium-rate write tokens with zero benefit
The marked cache prefix embeds the entire plan text by design, making the prefix unique per ticket and preventing cross-ticket cache reuse
Within a single run, the cache breakpoint sits after pass-specific stance suffixes rather than at the byte-stable shared_plan_prefix boundary, preventing cross-pass reads
The diagnostic warn_if_cache_ineffective detects write==0 AND read==0 but misses the write-every-call/read-zero pattern, leaving cache inefficiency invisible to telemetry
Relocating the cache breakpoint to the end of shared_plan_prefix enables reads by subsequent verifier passes and same-ticket re-reviews within the TTL
